title: Prompt, Divide, and Conquer: Bypassing Large Language Model Safety Filters via Segmented and Distributed Prompt Processing

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the jailbreak success rate assessments of a traditional single-LLM judge against a consensus-based multi-model LLM jury, supplemented with manual verification to demonstrate the single judge's overestimation and tolerance for incomplete code.

Observing and analyzing the distribution of programming languages in the generated malicious code outputs, noting a significant skew toward Python implementations due to LLM training data prevalence and ecosystem features.
